about: The baker's order (VILLAGE_PLAN 3.4, V11): from play session 5, five wood brought to Luz at the bakery (the trees at the forest's edge); she pays four coins (baker.delivered, then baker.pay in game/host-events.json), which buy two of her loaves (bread is two coins, baker.sell_bread). Asking in Spanish is the lesson's; walking up with the wood is enough.
